technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by bearish structure, weak trend strength, and negative money flow; insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 29 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no senior conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (435.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 29 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI oversold (9 & 14) with stochastic bullish cross and extreme fear sentiment (22/100) create classic contrarian bounce setup near support at 182.95.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative CMF, bearish MACD, weak ADX trend strength, VIX crisis conditions, and earnings binary risk in 29 days eliminate confluence needed for high-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI oversold conditions and extreme fear sentiment (22/100) present contrarian bounce opportunity; price at support level (182.95) offers defined risk entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 29 days combined with VIX crisis conditions (435.2) and price trapped below all major moving averages creates unacceptable downside risk despite oversold technicals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical oversold signals conflict sharply with bearish structure, weak trend strength, and macro headwinds; sentiment contrarian but unconfirmed by fundamentals or smart money.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 14 positions in Information Technology sector; adding ADSK increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector without conviction from institutional or insider activity.
